name: Folterbank
looks: viewed from directly above, a long rectangular wooden frame lying flat on the floor with a plank bed in the middle, a wooden roller with spoked handles at each short end, ropes running from the rollers along the bed and short iron chains with open shackles at the corners
viewed from straight above, a heavy timber rack: a flat plank bed between two thick side beams, a turning roller at the head and at the foot, coiled ropes and iron cuffs lying on the bed

name: Blutopfer-Altar
looks: viewed from directly above, the flat rectangular top of a dark basalt altar block with carved spiral ornaments along its rim, dark red dried blood stains in the middle and a lit candle with a small flame standing at each of the four corners

viewed from straight above, a heavy black stone altar slab with a shallow carved channel around the edge, splashes of dried dark red blood on the top surface and four melted candles with small flames at the corners

name: Hexenkessel über Feuer
motiv: black iron cauldron over a campfire
looks: viewed from directly above, the round open mouth of a black iron cauldron filled with bubbling green brew, standing in a ring of grey stones with glowing orange embers and small flames around it, a few charred logs pointing outward
viewed from straight above, a sooty round cauldron with a thick rim and bubbling dark green liquid, set over a campfire of crossed logs with glowing coals inside a ring of stones

name: Skelett am Boden
motiv: human skeleton lying on the ground
looks: viewed from directly above, a complete human skeleton lying flat on its back with its arms at its sides, scraps of torn brown cloth over the ribs and pelvis, the skull turned slightly to one side
viewed from straight above, an old yellowed human skeleton sprawled flat on the floor, one arm stretched out, tattered grey rags draped over the ribcage and a few loose finger bones beside it

name: Juwelentruhe
looks: viewed from directly above, an open rectangular wooden chest with iron corner bands, its inside heaped with gold coins and coloured gems; the opened lid lies flat behind it towards the top edge of the picture as a second wooden rectangle
viewed from straight above, an iron-bound wooden chest with its lid thrown fully back towards the top of the picture, the box brimming with gold coins, rubies and emeralds

name: Waffenständer
looks: viewed from directly above, a long narrow rectangular wooden frame standing on the floor, with swords, axes and spears lying side by side across its top bars, all blades pointing towards the top edge of the picture

viewed from straight above, a narrow wooden weapon stand whose top rail holds a neat row of weapons seen from above: sword pommels and crossguards, axe heads and spear points in one line along the rail

name: Katapult
looks: viewed from directly above, a rectangular wooden base frame on four wooden wheels, a long throwing arm lying along its middle with a round cup holding a large stone at the far end, a crossbar and coiled ropes at the near end

viewed from straight above, a heavy timber catapult: a square frame with a wooden wheel at each corner and the throwing arm pulled down flat along the frame, a big round stone resting in the cup at its end

name: Rammbock
looks: viewed from directly above, a long rectangular pitched roof of overlapping wooden planks covering the siege engine, the dark iron ram head sticking out at the front end towards the top edge of the picture, four wooden wheels just visible at the corners under the roof edge

viewed from straight above, a long tree-trunk battering ram with a dark iron head lying on a rectangular wooden carriage, the trunk running down the middle between two plank side walls, four spoked wheels at the corners

name: Bärenfalle
looks: viewed from directly above, an open steel bear trap lying flat: two round toothed jaws spread wide into a circle around a small square trigger plate, a short rusty chain with a ring attached to one side
viewed from straight above, a rusty iron leghold trap set open on the floor, its two semicircular jaws with jagged teeth lying flat, flat springs on both sides and a chain trailing off

name: Bodenleuchter
looks: viewed from directly above, five white candles with small lit flames arranged in a circle on the curling arms of a black wrought iron candelabra, drips of wax, the arms spreading out like a star from the centre
viewed from straight above, a black iron floor candelabra seen as a small star of curved arms, each ending in a round drip pan holding a lit candle with a bright little flame

name: Galgen
looks: viewed from directly above, a square wooden platform of planks with a dark square trapdoor in the middle, a tall wooden post at one side with a crossbeam reaching over the trapdoor and a rope noose hanging from its end
viewed from straight above, a raised plank scaffold on a low stone base, one thick upright beam and its horizontal arm extending across, a coiled rope with a noose dangling over the trapdoor

name: Pranger
motiv: wooden pillory stocks on a stone platform
looks: viewed from directly above, a small square platform of grey stone slabs, in its middle a wooden pillory: a long horizontal hinged plank board with three round holes, iron hinges and a padlock, resting on a thick post
viewed from straight above, a low rectangular stone platform carrying the long wooden top board of the stocks with holes for head and hands, iron bands and a heavy lock

name: Aufgeschlagenes Zauberbuch
motiv: open spellbook on a wooden lectern
looks: viewed from directly above, a thick old book lying open on the slanted top of a dark wooden lectern, its two pages covered with faint glowing blue circles and star diagrams instead of writing, a red ribbon bookmark
viewed from straight above, an ancient leather-bound tome lying open on a carved wooden reading stand, the pages showing glowing arcane circles and geometric patterns without any letters

name: Kristallkugel
motiv: crystal ball on an ornate bronze stand
looks: viewed from directly above, a perfectly round clear crystal sphere with swirling violet mist inside, resting in a bronze stand whose three curled claw feet spread out beyond the sphere
viewed from straight above, a glowing glass orb filled with pale blue light and mist, sitting on an ornate brass tripod with curling legs

name: Goldhaufen
motiv: pile of gold coins and treasure
looks: viewed from directly above, a roughly round heap of gold coins with scattered rubies, sapphires and emeralds, a golden goblet and a pearl necklace half buried in it, loose coins around the edge
viewed from straight above, a low mound of shining gold coins and coloured gemstones with a small golden crown and a jewelled dagger lying on top

name: Gemüseauslage
motiv: medieval wooden market stall selling vegetables
looks: viewed from directly above, a rectangular wooden market stall: along the top edge of the picture a slanted canvas awning with broad red and cream stripes, along the bottom edge the open front counter covered with wicker baskets of green cabbages, orange carrots, onions and red apples

viewed from straight above, a small vegetable stall whose back half is a red-and-cream striped canvas roof and whose front half is a wooden counter full of round baskets with cabbages, carrots, leeks and apples

name: Brotauslage
looks: viewed from directly above, a rectangular wooden market stall: along the top edge of the picture a slanted mustard yellow canvas awning, along the bottom edge the open front counter with round golden loaves, braided breads and pretzels in flat wicker baskets
viewed from straight above, a small bread stall with a mustard yellow canvas roof over its back half and a wooden counter in front holding baskets of crusty loaves, rolls and pretzels

name: Töpferwaren
looks: viewed from directly above, a rectangular wooden market stall: along the top edge of the picture a slanted plain cream canvas awning, along the bottom edge the open front counter with rows of round terracotta pots, jugs and glazed bowls seen from above as circles
viewed from straight above, a potter's stall with a cream canvas roof over its back half and a wooden counter in front lined with round clay pots, jugs and blue glazed bowls

name: Gewürzauslage
looks: viewed from directly above, a rectangular wooden market stall: along the top edge of the picture a slanted orange and purple striped canvas awning, along the bottom edge the open front counter with open burlap sacks and round bowls heaped with red, yellow, ochre and brown spice powders
viewed from straight above, a spice stall with an orange-and-purple striped roof over its back half and in front open sacks and bowls of colourful spice powders in neat rows

name: Händlerzelt (rund)
looks: viewed from directly above, one round canvas tent roof filling the picture: alternating orange and cream fabric panels radiating from a small central pole tip, a scalloped fabric rim around the edge and a small pennant at the top
viewed from straight above, the circular roof of a merchant pavilion made of wedge-shaped panels in deep red and cream meeting at a central finial, with a scalloped hem all around

name: Handkarren
looks: viewed from directly above, a wooden hand cart: a rectangular plank bed loaded with burlap sacks and a small barrel, a spoked wooden wheel on each side and two long wooden handles pointing towards the bottom edge of the picture
viewed from straight above, a two-wheeled wooden barrow with low plank sides holding sacks and a crate, its two shafts reaching out towards the bottom of the picture

name: Kornsäcke
looks: viewed from directly above, a small heap of six bulging burlap sacks tied at the top with string, one sack open and spilling golden wheat grain
viewed from straight above, a cluster of round, tightly packed burlap grain sacks with tied necks, a little spilled grain on the floor beside them

name: Kisten
looks: viewed from directly above, four square wooden crates pushed together in a block, their nailed plank lids and rope handles visible, one smaller crate stacked on top
viewed from straight above, a group of square wooden crates with plank lids and iron corner brackets, arranged in a tight cluster with one crate on top of the others

name: Hackklotz
looks: viewed from directly above, one round sawn tree stump showing its growth rings, an axe embedded in the top with its handle lying across, pale wood chips scattered around the base
viewed from straight above, a thick round chopping block with clear growth rings and cut marks, a woodcutter's axe stuck in it, a few split logs and wood chips around it

name: Holztrog
looks: viewed from directly above, one long rectangular wooden trough made of thick planks with iron bands, lying horizontally across the picture, filled to the brim with clear dark water
viewed from straight above, a long narrow plank trough with iron corner straps running from left to right, full of still blue-grey water

name: Stadtbrunnen
looks: viewed from directly above, one round carved stone fountain basin filled with blue water, a central stone column with a small bowl spilling water, a wide stone rim around it
viewed from straight above, a circular fountain with a broad rim of pale cut stones, rippling blue water inside and a small round basin on a pillar in the centre

name: Salatbeet
looks: viewed from directly above, one rectangular raised garden bed with a wooden plank border, dark rich soil and neat rows of leafy green lettuce, cabbages and carrot tops
viewed from straight above, a rectangular garden plot edged with planks, dark soil with straight rows of young lettuce heads and feathery carrot leaves

name: Grabplatte (bemoost)
looks: viewed from directly above, one flat rectangular grey stone grave slab lying on the ground with a simple carved cross, patches of green moss and lichen, chipped edges
viewed from straight above, an old weathered stone tomb slab with a worn carved cross in the middle, cracked corners and soft green moss in the grooves

name: Windmühle
looks: viewed from directly above, the round conical thatched roof of one stone windmill tower in the centre with four long wooden lattice sails spreading out in an X shape
viewed from straight above, a round mill tower roof of grey wooden shingles at the centre and four long sails of wooden lattice with cream canvas reaching out diagonally to the corners

name: Segelboot
looks: viewed from directly above, one small wooden sailing boat pointing towards the top of the picture: a pointed planked hull with a deck and two benches, a single mast with a furled cream sail along the boom
viewed from straight above, a narrow wooden boat seen lengthwise from bow at the top to stern at the bottom, its plank deck, a coil of rope, a mast with the cream sail rolled up

name: Pavillon
looks: viewed from directly above, the octagonal roof of one wooden garden gazebo covered in dark wooden shingles, eight roof segments meeting at a small finial in the centre
viewed from straight above, an eight-sided gazebo roof of overlapping brown shingles with a small round cap at the top, its eaves forming a neat octagon

name: Marktstand (gestreift)
looks: viewed from directly above, one flat rectangular canvas awning roof with broad deep blue and white stripes running from top to bottom of the picture, a thin wooden pole tip at each of the four corners, a narrow strip of wooden counter with rolled bolts of crimson and saffron cloth visible along the bottom edge
viewed from straight above, a blue-and-white striped market roof on four poles, with rolls of colourful cloth peeking out from under its lower edge on a wooden counter

name: Marktstand (grün)
looks: viewed from directly above, one flat rectangular dark green canvas awning roof with a scalloped hem at the bottom edge, a wooden pole tip at each corner, a narrow wooden counter along the bottom edge holding a tray of silver fish on white crushed ice
viewed from straight above, a dark green market roof on four poles, and along its lower edge a wooden counter with silver fish laid on ice

name: Marktstand (Plane)
looks: viewed from directly above, one flat rectangular charcoal grey canvas awning roof with a wooden pole tip at each corner, a narrow wooden table along the bottom edge with steel swords and axes laid parallel and a round wooden shield
viewed from straight above, a grey canvas market roof on four poles, and along its lower edge a wooden table displaying swords, axes and a round shield

name: Heuhaufen
looks: viewed from directly above, one rounded dome of golden dry hay, a dense even surface of hay strands, slightly brighter at the top, a soft irregular round outline
viewed from straight above, a round heap of loose golden hay with wisps sticking out along its edge

name: Strohballen
motiv: row of three rectangular straw bales
looks: viewed from directly above, three rectangular golden straw bales lying side by side in one row from left to right, each tied with two strands of twine, nothing else
viewed from straight above, a neat row of three compact straw bales with visible twine bindings and a few loose straws at their edges

name: Amboss
motiv: blacksmith anvil on a tree stump
looks: viewed from directly above, a black iron anvil with its flat polished steel face and pointed horn, resting on a round wooden stump whose growth rings show around the anvil
viewed from straight above, a heavy dark anvil with a gleaming worn top face and a tapering horn, mounted on a thick sawn log, a hammer lying beside it on the stump

name: Schmiedeesse
looks: viewed from directly above, one square hearth built of rough grey stones with a thick soot-blackened rim, a sunken bed of glowing orange and red coals in the middle, a brown leather bellows lying against one side
viewed from straight above, a square stone forge with a sooty rim, glowing coals in its central fire pit and a pair of leather bellows on one side

name: Hühnerstall
motiv: chicken coop with a small fenced run
looks: viewed from directly above like a map, so that the coop on the left is seen only as its roof: a flat rectangle of grey-brown wooden planks divided by a straight ridge line down the middle, no walls, no door and no front side visible. On the right a square pen fenced with woven willow, straw on the ground and three white hens seen from above as small white ovals

a strict bird's-eye view of a tiny farmyard corner: on the left only the plank roof of a small hen house, a plain rectangle with a ridge line; on the right a square wicker-fenced run with straw and three white chickens seen from above; no side of the hen house is visible

top-down map view: a rectangular wooden shingle roof of a little chicken coop on the left, directly next to it a small square pen of woven willow with straw and three white hens, everything seen straight from above with no perspective

name: Fischernetz
motiv: fishing net spread flat on the ground
looks: viewed from directly above, one large brown knotted fishing net spread completely flat in a rough rectangle, round cork floats along one edge and a coil of rope in a corner
viewed from straight above, a wide brown fishing net laid out flat to dry, its square mesh clearly visible, a row of cork floats along one side and a few dried leaves caught in it

name: Bienenkorb
looks: viewed from directly above, one single round dome-shaped straw bee skep standing alone: tight coiled straw rings forming concentric circles up to the top, warm golden straw colour
viewed from straight above, a solitary woven straw beehive dome, its coiled straw bands forming rings around a small rounded top, nothing else around it
